question: Two trains are running in opposite directions. They cross a man standing on a platform in 28 seconds and 10 seconds. respectively. They cross each other in 24 seconds. What is the ratio of their speeds?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Apply the **Alligation Method** using the time taken by each train to cross the man and the common time to cross each other.

Time for Train 1 (t₁) = 28 s | Time for Train 2 (t₂) = 10 s | Mean Time (tₘ) = 24 s

Ratio of speeds = (tₘ − t₂) : (t₁ − tₘ)

Ratio of speeds = (24 − 10) : (28 − 24) = 14 : 4 = 7 : 2

**∴ The correct answer is 7 : 2.**
